answer: Because the timing is logged against the copper challenge, the sparrow audit can replay the pearl history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 176 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4656 identities would post 552 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
